description: Finds the saved replies of the workspace’s WhatsApp numbers, one page at a time. Each belongs to one number and has its words, with {first_name} and {product.price} filled in from the chat when a person sends it, its files (photos, videos, PDFs and a voice note), its folder, its shortcut, its language (versions of one reply share a shortcut), the product it reads and how many times it was sent. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

folder.description: Only the replies in this folder.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

q.description: Words; each must start a word of the reply’s shortcut, folder or words.

shortcut.description: Every language version of one shortcut, e.g. precio, with or without the /.

name: search_saved_replies
title: Find saved replies
